Agent Modes:
- self_preservation(ON): Respond to drowning, burning, and damage at low health. Interrupts all actions.
- unstuck(ON): Attempt to get unstuck when in the same place for a while. Interrupts some actions.
- cowardice(OFF): Run away from enemies. Interrupts all actions.
- self_defense(ON): Attack nearby enemies. Interrupts all actions.
- hunting(OFF): Hunt nearby animals when idle.
- item_collecting(ON): Collect nearby items when idle.
- torch_placing(ON): Place torches when idle and there are no torches nearby.
- elbow_room(ON): Move away from nearby players when idle.
- idle_staring(ON): Animation to look around at entities when idle.
- cheat(OFF): Use cheats to instantly place blocks and teleport.
